about_the_game:
Build, Manage, and Grow Your Own Gaming Store!

Welcome to Digital Market Simulator, where you take charge of your own gaming store, sell video games and gaming-related products, and expand your business! Manage your inventory, design your store, and maximize profits as you create the ultimate shopping experience for gamers.

Features:

🎮 Run Your Own Store – Sell video games, consoles, and accessories while managing your stock and pricing strategy.
🌙 Day-Night Cycle & Home Life – Work during the day, then head home to rest and prepare for the next business day.
🛒 Showcase & Sell Products – Display your items on shelves and attract customers.
🔨 Customizable Store Design – Paint your store’s floors and walls to create your unique space.
🚀 Ever-Evolving Gameplay – A deep and dynamic system that continues to expand with new features and improvements.


Are you ready to build the ultimate gaming store? Start your journey in Digital Market Simulator today!

Customize Your Store As You Wish

Dynamically Changing Weather

Night-Day Cycle

name: Digital Market Simulator

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i3-9100 / AMD Ryzen 3 3200G
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1050 Ti / AMD Radeon RX 570
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 4 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX 11 Compatible
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10 / Windows 11 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-12400 / AMD Ryzen 5 5600X
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA RTX 3060 / AMD Radeon RX 6600
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 4 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX 12 Compatible

short_description: Run a marketplace where you can sell games and everything related, take care of customers and shape it however you want.
